dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Pronounced, smooth narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-body toward the posterior, forming a sharp V-shaped taper.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Asymmetrical inward curvature observed on the left lateral margin relative to the more uniform convex right margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey median intensity, significantly depigmented compared to neonate stages but retaining uniform grey hue without white maturation.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-frequency dark-grey curvilinear clusters visible across the left and central-anterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Low-contrast, diffuse gradient transitions between the primary light-grey baseline and localized darker grey mottling.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Fine, dark linear contrast marks visible on the left anterior-lateral plane, consistent with superficial epidermal scoring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial linear marks (potential rake marks) clustered on the left side of the dorsal ridge.
